Language: en

eHealth Infrastructure Test Data

The official URL for this implementation guide is: 

http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/testdata/ImplementationGuide/dk.ehealth.sundhed.fhir.ig.testdata

Test data resources for the Danish eHealth Infrastructure, defined in FSH against the profiles of its Implementation Guide.

grouping.name: Base.Individuals
grouping.description: The people the test data is about.

grouping.name: Base.Management
grouping.description: The episode of care the plan is delivered under, and that every record of care refers back to.

grouping.name: Clinical.Care Provision
grouping.description: The plan as delivered to the patient: the care plan, the service requests it consists of, and the care team responsible.

grouping.name: Clinical.Diagnostics
grouping.description: What the patient submitted: the measurements and the questionnaire responses.

grouping.name: Clinical.Summary
grouping.description: The clinical record: the diagnosis each episode addresses, and the triage result of each submission. The impressions are not loaded — automated processing creates them, and the ones here record what it should produce.

grouping.name: Foundation.Security
grouping.description: One Provenance per submission, naming the resources submitted together. This is what triggers automated processing.

grouping.name: Base.Workflow
grouping.description: The assessment task raised with each triage result. Not loaded either, and its priority is the triage colour.

grouping.name: Specialized.Definitional Artifacts
grouping.description: The plan, the activities it is built from, the questionnaire and the automated-processing rules.

grouping.name: Foundation.Other
grouping.description: Settings the loader reads before it loads anything. Not test data, and not created on the target.

resource.name: Pulse
resource.description: Heart rate, triaged against absolute thresholds: red at or below 50 and at or above 130, yellow either side of the 60-110 green band.

resource.name: Questionnaire
resource.description: Master Questionnaire activity presenting the symptom questionnaire, the single questionnaire of this plan.

resource.name: Oxygen saturation and pulse (same device group)
resource.description: The same-device group: one pulse oximeter, one patient action, two values. Its children are the saturation and the pulse.

resource.name: Oxygen saturation and pulse measurement
resource.description: Guidance shown before the saturation and pulse measurement: warm the hands, and what the reading involves.

resource.name: Preparation
resource.description: Immediate preparation: sit still for five minutes beforehand and keep the hand steady during the reading.

resource.name: Oxygen saturation
resource.description: Oxygen saturation, triaged against absolute thresholds: red at or below 85%, yellow up to 88%, green above.

resource.name: COPD questionnaire
resource.description: COPD symptom questionnaire: treatment status, three symptom scales, sputum colour and a conditional comment. Eighteen answer-significance mappings across green, yellow and red.

resource.name: observation-absolute-range-triage
resource.description: Triages a submitted observation against absolute thresholds expressed in the observation's own unit. Reads the reference ranges from the observation it is given, so a measurement must carry them to be assessed; a GAL range yields a yellow assessment and a RAL range a red one.

resource.name: questionnaire-response-triage-on-answersignificance
resource.description: Triages a submitted questionnaire response by matching each answer against the answer-significance mappings on the questionnaire, and recording one finding basis per answered question alongside the overall assessment.
